_about: The design rules the Staging design rules duty (scripts/duties/staging-design-rules.ts) matches the owner's notes against. Each rule names the ledger corrections and the frontend-implementation skill phrase that hold it, the date that skill text was written, the patterns of the owner's own words for it, the virev-demo unit tests that catch it by script (`tests`), and the same tests in the real app, apps/search on us-metal02 (`searchTests`). A rule with neither a correction in force nor its skill phrase is not written down yet. `handled` lists repeated notes already dealt with, each by its log timestamp and the auto-sns-agent commits that wrote its skill line and fixed its pages; such a repeat leaves the headline once all those commits are on origin at the Mac's dev branch (dev/sieun-mac), which the duty reads from the Mac checkout's agent.branch or current branch.

rules.rule: Every screen uses the one shared component set, in the same style and order as the other apps, and never draws its own version.
A screen carries no filler copy, helper text or explanation, only fields, text and counts that mean something.
Surfaces, text and tables stay crisp, with no washed-out grey.
Screens stay compact, with no fat, tall or padded containers and no extra spacing.
A choice uses OptionGroup or ViewSwitch and never a pill or a grey pill track.
Blue marks only a commonly used clickable action; lower-impact controls are black and count badges are grey.
rules.skill: ONLY should indicate a commonly used clickable

rules.rule: A full list loads on scroll and never shows a Load more button.
A long list inside a dashboard shows up to 10 rows, then Show all N.
Adding to a list uses the + Add row and an inline field that saves on Enter, with no Add and Cancel pair and no keyboard hint text.
rules.skill: Add cancel like this is super ugly

rules.rule: Every popup renders through FormPanel, with one fixed width, rounded corners, one scroll area and a form that grows downward.
rules.skill: ALL popup panal component MUST have same width

rules.rule: Each section title, option and key field carries its icon, the same icon the sidebar uses.
rules.skill: keep icons for each section where possible

rules.rule: Important text is never truncated, rows stay on one line, and links and buttons never wrap.
View switches, resizes and panels animate smoothly everywhere.
Nothing on a screen is unintentional, arbitrary or unclear about what to do next.
